body: Remove or justify the `size_scale.powf(2.5).min(2.0)` multiplier in the per-adult daily feed calculation in `collect_stocked_metrics` (e2e_geometry_scaling.rs:162-164). This factor causes larger tanks to receive more feed per adult per day (1× at scale 1.0 vs 2× at scale 2.0), introducing a non-linear nitrogen load per liter that confounds the scaling comparison. If the intent is to test equal per-liter loading, feed per adult should be constant across scales.
